Under UCITS Regulation 26(2), the general rule is one dealing cut-off for all unit classes. **Express 2026 exceptions** permit different cut-offs for: (1) subscriptions/redemptions settled in cash versus those settled in-kind; and (2) currency-hedged versus unhedged classes. These are regulatory exceptions, not case-by-case waivers.

That differs from the older **ESMA Q&A 1030** approach: it treated different cut-offs for hedged and unhedged classes as potentially acceptable only where the manager obtained a **Central Bank of Ireland derogation/waiver**, supported by operational reasons and safeguards against unfair treatment of investors. The Q&A did not itself create a general permission.

So, as of 6 November 2026, distinguish the new express carve-outs in Regulation 26(2) from the historic waiver route under Q&A 1030. Different cut-offs still need to be clearly disclosed and operated consistently with fair treatment and equal treatment of investors.
